MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory card and external drive fit my repeated use of camera storage: they could help me capture more photos and back up files, provided they work with my equipment.",
    "The HD Fire TV Stick offers a useful new function for my 720p TV, so it feels more relevant than replacing a device I already have."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The USB-C cable and HDMI-to-DVI adapter are electronics accessories, but neither matches a connection I currently need; the exact connector matters to me.",
    "The Echo Dot and Echo Wall Clock do not address an expressed need, and the clock requires an Echo device I am not known to own.",
    "Another Fire 7 duplicates my existing tablet, while the 4K streaming stick and ten-port hub offer capabilities I have no clear use for right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in more Amazon devices, although my purchases do not establish a need for voice assistants or another tablet.",
    "My frequent accessory purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any cable or expansion device, regardless of the equipment it connects to."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases often solve specific equipment needs, so connector type, device compatibility and a clear practical purpose matter more than a broad electronics resemblance.",
    "What I already own matters: another memory card can add useful storage, but another reader or tablet needs a clearer reason to justify duplication."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical electronics and storage needs but sometimes overlook compatibility, existing equipment and whether an added capability solves a current problem."
}
